_what: Every tracked file in the app brick template, with its measured size and what chassis step 4 does with it.
_why: ADR 065 set step 4 a target of ~205 lines. ADR 066 measured that as unsourced and unreachable and put the floor at ~2,900-3,550.
BOTH figures counted lib/ and the translations only. Measured 2026-09-05 the template is 18,205 lines across 96 files, and the
inherited test suite alone is 7,678 of them - 42% - which appears in no plan. That is three wrong numbers for one step, each
So the number stops living in prose. Every file gets a row; assert-chassis-ledger.mjs keeps the rows and the tree in bijection,
recomputes every count, and refuses a MOVE whose call site does not shrink. Nothing here is trusted - it is all re-measured.
MEASURED, not assumed: an undeclared file added to the brick reddened ZERO of the 127 assert-*.mjs guards on 2026-09-05
(17 were red both before and after, all of them needing build artifacts, credentials or CLI args). This ledger is the first
thing that makes the template a declared set.
_rootsNote: TWO roots since 2026-09-07 ([ADR 067] phase 2, unit app-shell). The Worker half of the template - 13 files, 917 lines every stamped backend app inherits - was outside this ledger entirely while `root` was one string, and `git ls-files -- <that one root>` could not see it to complain. assert-chassis-ledger.mjs is the authority on this list and cross-checks it; a row's `root` is optional and defaults to roots[0], which is why the 96 rows written against the single root are unchanged. ⏱ THE FIGURES IN THIS NOTE MOVED ON 2026-09-08 AND ARE CORRECTED RATHER THAN REWRITTEN: the Worker half is now 14 files and 1,021 lines, because the template gained src/lib/error-sink.ts — a stamped backend had NO crash sink at all and failed tooling/ci/assert-worker-error-sink.mjs on limbs 2, 3 and 5 at its first CI run. The guard PRINTS both figures per root on every run, which is the number to read; this sentence is prose and prose rots.

verdicts.STAYS: This file is per-app by construction, or a guard requires it to remain here. It is not step 4 work.
verdicts.MOVES: Its content belongs in a shared package. REQUIRES a measured callSiteDelta, and that delta MUST be negative - ADR 066: a screen moves only when the calling code measurably shrinks.
verdicts.GOES: Deleted outright because nothing points at it any more. REQUIRES a measured callSiteDelta of 0 or less.
verdicts.UNCLASSIFIED: No verdict has been measured yet. This count is a ratchet: it may fall, never rise.

AND THE HEADROOM IS SMALLER THAN IT LOOKS: 6,608 of these 15,560 lines (42%) are comment or blank. Removing them would be measurable progress against a number and a real loss. Step 4 shrinks CODE.
